plugins.name: robin
plugins.description: Find, compare, save, and apply to Swiss property listings with Robin.

skills.name: apply-to-listing
skills.description: Send one authenticated contact request for an exact RobinReal or eligible Comparis listing. Use only after the user explicitly asks to apply, send, or contact, including the widget Apply button. This is a destructive external action; do not use for browsing, comparing, favoriting, vague interest, unsupported providers, or unrelated requests.
skills.description_zh: 在用户明确要求申请、发送或联系后，为指定 RobinReal 或符合条件的 Comparis 房源发出一次已认证联系请求；不用于浏览、比较、收藏、模糊兴趣或不支持的提供方。

skills.name: save-favorite-listing
skills.description: Add or remove one Robin listing from the user's favorites, with one safe OAuth recovery. Use when the user explicitly asks to save, favorite, bookmark, unsave, or remove a listing, including a widget favorite button. Do not use for browsing, comparing, applying, unrelated requests, or merely viewing a listing.
skills.description_zh: 按用户明确请求将一条 Robin 房源加入或移出收藏，可进行一次安全 OAuth 恢复；不用于浏览、比较、申请或仅查看房源。

skills.name: search-and-show-listings
skills.description: Search Swiss Robin real-estate inventory. Use for rent or sale, including homes, commercial property, parking, land, hospitality, agriculture, secondary rooms, and gardens. Do not use for legal or unrelated requests.
skills.description_zh: 搜索瑞士 Robin 出租或出售房源，覆盖住宅、商业物业、停车位、土地、酒店、农业、附属房间和花园；不用于法律或无关请求。

skills.name: show-recommended-listings
skills.description: Render the best supported Swiss real-estate listings for an authenticated user's latest Robin search profile. Use for personalized recommendations, listings for the user, profile matches, best-match ordering, or newest personalized matches. Do not use for ordinary criteria searches, anonymous browsing, profile synthesis or persistence, unsupported categories, or unrelated requests.
skills.description_zh: 依据已认证用户最新 Robin 搜索档案展示受支持的最佳匹配瑞士房源，适用于个性化推荐、匹配排序和最新匹配；不用于普通条件搜索、匿名浏览、档案生成持久化或不支持类别。

skills.name: sign-in-to-robin
skills.description: Start or confirm Robin account linking with `sign_in`. Use when the Robin plugin is active and the user explicitly asks to sign in, connect, link, or access Robin, including its direct sign-in button. Do not use for unrelated sign-in requests; favorite and application skills own their authentication recovery.
skills.description_zh: 在 Robin 插件启用且用户明确要求登录、连接或访问时，通过 sign_in 开始或确认账号关联；不处理无关登录，收藏和申请技能自行管理其认证恢复。

skills.name: update-search-profile
skills.description: Manage a verified user's personalized Robin search profile. Use only for Robin's due search-history contract; do not use for ordinary edits, anonymous users, or unrelated requests.
skills.description_zh: 管理已核验用户的个性化 Robin 搜索档案，仅适用于 Robin 规定的到期搜索历史流程；不用于普通修改、匿名用户或无关请求。
